newsitem.title: FINLAND: Stockmann to issue FIM 300 mln bond.
newsitem.headline: Stockmann to issue FIM 300 mln bond.

text.p: Finnish retailing group Stockmann Oy said in a statement on Tuesday it would issue up to 300 million markka in four-year 5.50 percent coupon bonds to big investors.
"The subscription period for the bond is October 4 to 18 1996," it said, adding that subscriptions could be submitted to Postipankki's Fixed Income Sales.
The bond would be listed on the Helsinki Stock Exchange.
Stockmann said its sales and results after the January-June interim published in August had developed as expected and it had nothing to add to the outlook stated in that report.
"The board is still of the opinion that the 1996 profit before extraordinary items, voluntary provisions and income taxes will be at least as good as it was in 1995," Stockmann said.
In 1995, group profit was 280 million markka.
The issue will be arranged by Postipankki Oy.
